title: Customizations
description: V15's Environment → Workspace → Agent scope pickers (cascading, always set and synced to the active session), with each page shown as a table. Clicking a row or a Discover card opens a resizable right panel modeled on the Settings JSON panel. The panel defaults to a Rich UI view; a header picker switches it to Editor, or to Output for MCP servers. MCP servers use the product's editable form (Server Type, Command/URL, Arguments, Environment Variables or Headers, Working Directory, Save/Discard). Copilot Connectors show a Preview badge, Disconnect/Connect, and Details, Contains and Other Information tables. Install/Connect are split buttons: one click installs for Copilot on This Computer at user level (toast offers Undo / Change Where…), and the dropdown opens the full install dialog. Plugins are always user-level.
